description: Verkeersborden.Vlaanderen - Borden is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Agentschap Wegen en Verkeer. Puntenlaag van alle verkeersborden zoals opgenomen in de Verkeersborden.Vlaanderen toepassing. Deze worden voorgesteld al een punt per bord en dus zullen er meerdere punten op elkaar liggen indien de opstelling bestaat uit meerdere borden. Als attribuut kan je buiten de bordcode en het mogelijke opschrift ook de grootte van het bord, opstelhoogte,... terugvinden. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in CSV. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are MMTIS. The portal shows 2024-12-18 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
